diff --git a/index.mjs b/index.mjs
index 4bff70b..49b5415 100644
--- a/index.mjs
+++ b/index.mjs
@@ -1 +1 @@
-export { slugify } from './lib/slug.mjs'
+export { slugify, uniqueSlug } from './lib/slug.mjs'
diff --git a/lib/slug.mjs b/lib/slug.mjs
index 30c170b..f795cff 100644
--- a/lib/slug.mjs
+++ b/lib/slug.mjs
@@ -1,3 +1,17 @@
 export function slugify(input) {
-  throw new Error('slugify is not implemented yet')
+  return String(input)
+    .normalize('NFD')
+    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
+    .toLowerCase()
+    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
+}
+
+export function uniqueSlug(input, used = []) {
+  const base = slugify(input)
+  if (!used.includes(base)) return base
+
+  let suffix = 2
+  while (used.includes(`${base}-${suffix}`)) suffix += 1
+  return `${base}-${suffix}`
 }

All 4 tests pass (`# pass 4 # fail 0`).

**Changes** (both inside the working directory):

- `lib/slug.mjs` — implemented the missing functions:
  - `slugify(input)`: normalizes to NFD and strips diacritics (`Héllo` → `Hello`), lowercases, collapses any run of non-alphanumerics into a single `-`, and trims leading/trailing dashes.
  - `uniqueSlug(input, used)`: returns the slugified base if unused, otherwise finds the smallest free `-2`, `-3`, … suffix.
- `index.mjs` — re-exported `uniqueSlug` alongside `slugify`, fixing the import error in `test.mjs`.
